edits.old_fragment: **Universal practical authority: five connected advances, 8 October 2026.** [The current continuation](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md#16-连续推进理由可行接续迁移与冲突--reasons-effective-continuation-transfer-and-conflict) strengthens the internalist rival beyond expressly adopted goals, develops the affirmative account of criticizing ends, and tests the all-goals route to authority. **24 new Lean theorems / 35 declaration audits pass:** all outcome-goal guarantees are preserved exactly under live response refinement; heterogeneous finite revisions compose, while projections preserve only their declared content. Checked witnesses distinguish possibility growth, effective control, closure goals and joint feasibility. [Argument, correspondence and substantive self-counterreview](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#18-from-reasons-beyond-goals-to-controllable-continuation-transfer-and-conflict) connect these results to responsibilities, transfer and endings. Williams is read directly at the stated passage scope; the further author-source comparison retains access limits. Universal first ethical warrant remains open; the completed G0/J route is neither reopened nor renamed. **Next:** warrant beyond the full deliberatively available motivational organization, distinguishing recognition of a reason from creation of a new concern. / 连续推进五个连接；数学结果认证可实现性保持，不认证能力、控制或任意目的的伦理意义。
edits.new_fragment: **Universal practical authority: direct first-ground audit, 8 October 2026.** [The current correction](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md#17-第一规范根据的直接审计--direct-audit-of-first-normative-warrant) removes the unnecessary requirement that universal reasons lie outside every sound deliberative route. [The full affirmative argument and self-counterreview](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#19-direct-audit-of-the-remaining-central-claim) distinguish actual organization, patient-relative good and already warranted response-specific favor. The first nonexclusive practical identification remains unproved; defining it as quality or supplying it to Lean would not establish it. The existing motivational-access, constitutive-answer and epistemic-authority studies are credited, with a bounded primary recheck of Korsgaard1986. **No new theorem or universal completion is claimed.** The earlier five connected advances and 24 checked practical-reach theorems retain scope. The remaining task is substantive warrant for the first identification, compatible with a justified universal learning route; no switch to the independently completed G0/J route is made. / 第一根据直接审计纠正额外门槛；普遍权威未证，已有条件性成果继续复用。

It supports implementation of warranted requirements while leaving first universal ethical authority under investigation.
edits.new_fragment: **普遍实践权威的第一根据 / First practical warrant:** [直接审计](unified-2026-10-05/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md#17-第一规范根据的直接审计--direct-audit-of-first-normative-warrant)纠正“普遍理由必须在全部适当思考之外”的额外门槛，保留最强肯定论证及其实质依赖。/ Universal authority remains unproved. The earlier five connected advances and 24 checked theorems/35 audits concern effective realization and transfer, with no new ethical proof or completion acceptance.

edits.old_fragment: **First practical authority → effective continuation → revision and conflict, 8 October 2026.** [The five-step continuation](ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md#16-连续推进理由可行接续迁移与冲突--reasons-effective-continuation-transfer-and-conflict) strengthens the reasons rival beyond expressly adopted goals and connects the affirmative assessment of ends to a checked all-outcome-goals characterization. Twenty-four new Lean theorems / 35 declaration audits distinguish possibility growth, controllable guarantees, goals about closure and actual joint feasibility. Arbitrary finite heterogeneous revisions compose; a projection can conceal a lost protection. These supply exact conditions for realizing an independently warranted requirement through transfer, not a proof that control, every goal or every new organization is good. First ethical authority beyond the whole deliberatively available motivational organization remains the central unresolved connection. Existing conditional responsibility and ending principles retain their G0/J premises. / 本轮连续推进多个连接；普遍伦理有效、跨目的弱能力保持与实际遵循分别说明。
edits.new_fragment: **First practical warrant: direct audit, 8 October 2026.** [The corrected target](ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md#17-第一规范根据的直接审计--direct-audit-of-first-normative-warrant) does not require universal reasons to be inaccessible through sound deliberation. The affirmative account still needs to warrant the nonexclusive practical bearing of actual living quality; common formation, recognition and effective control do not yet establish that identification. The earlier five-step continuation retains its 24 checked practical-reach theorems/35 audits and explicit limits concerning control, closure, projection, joint feasibility and finite heterogeneous revision. No new mathematical proof or universal ethical completion is claimed. The completed G0/J responsibility and ending principles remain reusable at their original scope. / 本轮纠正额外门槛并直接审计第一规范根据；未以新的条件性机制替代普遍证明。
